written.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini Robotics 2.5 with 96% factory success rate
written.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that achieved a 96% success rate on pick-and-pack tasks in Mercedes-Benz factories in Hungary and Germany. The release also includes ASIMOV-Jailbreak, an open-source benchmark for testing robot safety against adversarial prompts.

written.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price at $70–$78 per share, targeting $1.4 trillion valuation
written.summary: Anthropic filed an updated IPO prospectus on November 10, 2026, offering 825 million Class A shares at $70–$78 per share, implying a valuation of up to $1.404 trillion. The company expects to raise $57.75–$64.35 billion from the public offering, with total net proceeds of $84.6–$93.7 billion including a $26 billion private sale to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC.

written.headline: TSMC to invest up to $1B in Anthropic and OpenAI at IPO price
written.summary: TSMC has approved up to $500 million to buy shares in Anthropic at its IPO price and up to $500 million for preferred stock in OpenAI. The move follows Anthropic's IPO pricing of $70 to $78 per share and reflects TSMC's confidence in AI demand.

written.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to the public with agent swarm feature
written.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public via the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Antigravity, after a two-week limited release to cybersecurity defenders. The model is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens during an introductory period, and Google is previewing a "swarm" feature that turns a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents.

written.headline: Fable 5.2 tops Remote Labor Index at 41.3% of freelance jobs
written.summary: On the Remote Labor Index from Scale Labs and the Center for AI Safety, Anthropic's Fable 5.2 completes 41.3% of real freelance projects at professional quality, ahead of Opus 5.5 (21.25%) and GPT 6 Astra (20.83%). The score is up from 2.5% for the top system a year ago.

written.headline: Google unveils TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and large-scale AI workloads
written.summary: Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its eighth-generation tensor processing units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, targeting confidential inference and larger memory capacity for AI workloads. The 8tx, designed with AMD, is built for secure workloads, while the 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips to double memory, processing power and bandwidth.

written.headline: Anthropic targets $1.3tn valuation in IPO pricing 825 million shares at $70-$78
written.summary: Anthropic announced plans for an IPO valuing the company at up to $1.3tn, offering 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78 each. The offering could raise up to $64.35bn, with pricing set for November 18 and trading beginning November 19.

written.headline: TSMC board approves up to $1bn investment in Anthropic and OpenAI
written.summary: TSMC's board approved investments of up to $500 million in Anthropic at its IPO price and up to $500 million in OpenAI preferred stock. The world's largest contract chipmaker is seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion for Anthropic, which priced its IPO at $70–78 per share.

written.headline: Froncort.AI raises $2.3M from Google.org to expand AI disease surveillance
written.summary: Pune-based healthcare AI startup Froncort.AI has raised $2.3 million from Google.org, plus $200K in Google Cloud credits and pro bono technical expertise, to develop mAI-NETRA, a mobile version of its AI disease surveillance platform. The funding will extend the platform to six infectious diseases across up to eight high-burden districts in three Indian states, covering two to three million people.
